name: TieredCache::get / put

test_list.description: A key in no tier is Ok(None) and counts one miss.
put stores the value in L2 (with its scope) and in L1.
After an L1 purge, a get is served by L2 and the value is promoted: the next get is an L1 hit.
Hits, misses and promotions are counted per tier.
When L2 refuses the write, put returns the error and L1 holds nothing either.
With a fake clock, an entry past its TTL is a miss in L1 and in L2.
An L2 value without a valid envelope is CacheError::Codec, not a panic and not a hit.
get(put(k, v)) == v for arbitrary keys and values while capacity is not exceeded.

output_description: L1 -> L2 lookup with promotion; write-through put.
